_readme: Every word on the Elementoro site, in one file.
Each entry is one piece of text on the page.
text  what shows on the site - this is the bit you change
max   the word limit. Paste in more than this and the extra words are cut,
so a long paste cannot break the layout. Change the number if a line
should be allowed to run longer.
Safe to get wrong. If this file is missing, malformed, or a field is left
empty, that field falls back to the words the site was built with. Nothing
typed in here can take the page down.
Not in here: file names, colours, layer coordinates and the artist’s slugs.
Editing the LIVE site still needs a deploy - this file has to reach the host.
Regenerate after a source change with: node tools/make-content.mjs
Your edits are kept; only new fields are added.

bonds.BONDS.lead.text: As the 118 race to heal what was broken, they must uncover what came before bonds, before the Great Fracturing itself.

bonds.BONDS.laws[0].lines[0].text: Together they discover that every reaction — love or loss — obeys one universal law.

bonds.BONDS.laws[0].land.text: Nothing truly ends. It only changes form.

bonds.BONDS.laws[1].lines[0].text: And the oldest force in existence

bonds.BONDS.awareness[0].text: From connection, from memory, the universe begins to comprehend itself.

bonds.BONDS.awareness[1].text: Elementoro gives this a name, a story and a mythology: Awareness.

bonds.BONDS.close.lines[0].text: From the quantum to the cosmic,

bonds.BONDS.close.lines[1].text: we are always entangled in relation -

childhood.CHILDHOOD.opening.lines[0].text: Every child is born a scientist. Curious. Fearless. Always asking,

childhood.CHILDHOOD.wonder[0].text: Before they learn facts, they learn through wonder.

childhood.CHILDHOOD.thousand[0].text: They can name a thousand Pokémon.

childhood.CHILDHOOD.thousand[1].text: Walk with dinosaurs across lost worlds.

childhood.CHILDHOOD.stack[1].text.text: As characters. As friendships. As feelings.

childhood.CHILDHOOD.transforms.text: Elementoro transforms the hidden patterns of the universe - chemistry, physics, biology, geology, and more - into an adventure children can see, feel, and imagine.

childhood.CHILDHOOD.itself.lines[0].text: And now, after billions of years, the universe has become able to wonder about itself-

childhood.CHILDHOOD.requirement.text: The only requirement to join the adventure is boundless imagination.

closing.INVITATION.heading[1].text: A 4.1 Billion Year Journey to You.

closing.MADE_OF.lines[0].text: You are made of Carbon, Oxygen, Hydrogen, Nitrogen, Calcium, and Iron. The air you breathe is Nitrogen and Oxygen. The water you drink is Hydrogen and Oxygen. The ground beneath your feet is Silicon, Aluminium, and Iron.

closing.MADE_OF.lines[1].text: Everything in the known universe, every star, every ocean, every living creature, is made from the same 118 elements. The nature of every element is decided by the arrangement of electrons moving through its outermost shell. That single, elegant pattern decides whether an element shares or takes, builds or transforms, bonds or drifts alone.

closing.MAKERS.heading.text: Artist and Scientist: A Shared Vision of Wonder

closing.MAKERS.people[0].bio.text: Sheefali Asija is an interdisciplinary artist whose work bridges science, myth, and humanity. Elementoro grows from a profound love of science and storytelling, and from a personal legacy shaped by resilience, wonder, and the enduring power of love.

closing.MAKERS.people[1].bio.text: Dame Clare Grey, Professor of Chemistry at the University of Cambridge and Fellow of the Royal Society, is the scientific authority behind the Elementoro universe, driven by one belief: science must serve all human beings.

closing.PARTNERS.strands[2].text: Games, Digital and Board and Card

closing.PARTNERS.school.note.text: The Stephen Perse Junior School is the first school in the world to embed Elementoro across its curriculum, bringing the Quantum Tower into its outdoor space and the 118 superheroes into every classroom.

hundred18.BEATS[1].line.text: Oxy burns fierce but fears the fire inside her own heart.

hundred18.BEATS[2].line.text: Carr shifts through endless forms, never fully certain which one is truly hers.

hundred18.BEATS[3].line.text: Heli floats calmly above the chaos, hiding loneliness behind amusement.

hundred18.BEATS[4].line.text: So burns bright and gives everything he has to anyone who asks.

hundred18.BEATS[5].line.text: Mag holds the world together, while Iro and Cop are moving, building, and connecting realm to realm.

hundred18.BEATS[6].line.text: And deep underground, Ura glows quietly in the dark, carrying memories older than the realms themselves.

hundred18.INTRO.lead.text: The story of 118 starts with a few.

hundred18.OUTRO.lead.text: Every character carries extraordinary powers, dangerous weaknesses, ancient histories - and secrets even they do not fully understand.

hundred18.OUTRO.carry[7].text.text: secrets even they do not fully understand

hundred18.OUTRO.powers[1].line.text: Some can shape metal or crystal with a touch.

hundred18.OUTRO.powers[2].line.text: Some burn bright enough to ignite entire cities.

hundred18.OUTRO.powers[3].line.text: Others can vanish into silence, drift untouched through the skies, or dive deep beneath the fractured core of the world.

interstitial.REALMS_INTRO.line.text: Across the six realms, the 118 find themselves drawn into strange mysteries, buried histories, and impossible choices.

interstitial.TRUTH.heading[0].text: As the 118 race to heal what was broken,

interstitial.TRUTH.heading[1].text: they must uncover why the world chose

interstitial.TRUTH.heading[2].text: to forget where it came from -

interstitial.TRUTH.lines[0].text: And what came before the Great Fracturing?

interstitial.TRUTH.lines[1].text: And discover the truth that connection itself may be the oldest force in existence.

interstitial.TRUTH.laws[0].text: Every reaction, whether of love or loss, obeys the same law. Nothing truly ends. It only changes form.

interstitial.TRUTH.laws[1].text: Connection, not perfection, keeps the universe alive.

madeof.MADE_OF.nerveNote.body.text: Sodium rushes in, potassium rushes out, and the wave moves down the nerve. Calcium opens the gate so the message can cross.

madeof.MADE_OF.nerveNote.strong.text: Magnesium sits on the door where memories are made, standing aside only when the signal is worth keeping.

madeof.MADE_OF.heartNote.strong.text: Oxytocin - the molecule of bonding - is a ring held shut by a bridge of two sulfur atoms.

madeof.MADE_OF.heartNote.body.text: Fear is adrenaline in the blood and iron hauling oxygen to the muscles. Peace is chloride pouring through a channel until the noise falls quiet. Every feeling you have ever had was elements, arranged, responding.

prologue.PROLOGUE[0].blocks[4].text.text: Before the first journey ever began.

prologue.PROLOGUE[0].blocks[6].text.text: The first pattern from which all others were born.

prologue.PROLOGUE[1].blocks[2].text.text: for which there are no records, no stories, no memories.

prologue.PROLOGUE[1].blocks[12].text.text: Until the Universe forgot - its own story.

prologue.PROLOGUE[2].blocks[3].text.text: an event lost in the deep past.

prologue.PROLOGUE[2].blocks[5].text.text: No one knows what came before.

prologue.PROLOGUE[2].blocks[6].text.text: Recently, deep beneath the fractured valleys,

prologue.PROLOGUE[2].blocks[7].text.text: whispers are beginning to move through the stillness.

prologue.PROLOGUE[2].blocks[9].text.text: Crystal towers rise and vanish before dawn.

prologue.PROLOGUE[2].blocks[10].text.text: Lightning storms awaken strange new powers.

prologue.PROLOGUE[2].blocks[13].text.text: Ancient symbols appear in crystal and stone.

prologue.PROLOGUE[2].blocks[15].text.text: Lost songs are sung by those who have never heard them.

prologue.PROLOGUE[2].blocks[16].text.text: The old gods offer no answers.

prologue.PROLOGUE[2].blocks[18].text.text: They speak of The Great Remembering.

prologue.PROLOGUE[2].blocks[21].text.text: a voice speaks for the very first time.

quantum.QUANTUM.heading[0].text: The quest to understand the universe

quantum.QUANTUM.quiet.text: For thousands of years we searched the stars for answers.

quantum.QUANTUM.hidden[0].text: It is hidden within the fabric of reality itself.

quantum.QUANTUM.aware.lines[0].text: A code that shapes how the universe

quantum.QUANTUM.setup[0].text: The code is the number of electrons found in the energy shells of an atom of the 118 elements.

quantum.QUANTUM.claims[0].text: There can be only 7 energy shells.

quantum.QUANTUM.claims[1].text: And the arrangement of electrons across the 7 can be only — 2, 8, 18, 18, 32, 32, 18, 8.

quantum.TIMELINE.steps[0].body.text: Patterns in stone, fire, stars, and matter.

quantum.TIMELINE.steps[2].body.text: gave us Atom, the indivisible particle.

quantum.TIMELINE.steps[3].era.text: Each adding a piece to the puzzle

quantum.TIMELINE.steps[4].body.text: sees the pattern of periodic table.

quantum.TIMELINE.steps[5].body.text: turns the table into a story telling Universe.

realms.REALMS[0].lines[0].text: A wilderness of cloud forests, wetlands and flowering valleys, where life is endlessly created and reborn. The Keepers feel everything intensely; every bond carries a cost.

realms.REALMS[0].lines[1].text: They honour Jivara, Guardian of Life, and Prana, Keeper of Breath. Yet the oldest myths, which speak of the Ancients – the Weaver of all bonds, the Composer whose song rises from countless small things, the River of time itself – are beginning to emerge again.

realms.REALMS[0].lines[2].text: Now ancient pathways surface beneath the tangled roots. Rivers return to forgotten courses. Strange clearings appear in the oldest forests.

realms.REALMS[0].cast[0].line.text: keeps finding places she swears were not there the day before.

realms.REALMS[0].cast[1].line.text: chases every impossible path, convinced each mystery is another adventure waiting to unfold.

realms.REALMS[0].cast[2].line.text: quietly records every change, certain the forests are trying to tell a forgotten story.

realms.REALMS[1].lines[0].text: A kingdom of glittering mountain cities, clockwork towns and soaring bridges, where every street echoes with invention. At its heart rises the Hall of Impossible Ideas - where failed experiments and unfinished inventions are treasured alongside the greatest masterpieces, because every impossible idea might one day change the world. The Forge Clans burn bright and give everything to those they trust.

realms.REALMS[1].lines[1].text: They honour Kara, Master of the Forge, and Silpin, Keeper of Form. The oldest forge songs also remember the Ancients - the Keeper who binds the heart of matter, the Weaver of every metal and magnet, and the Transformer, a hidden power that lets matter itself change - though few now recall why their names were ever spoken.

realms.REALMS[1].lines[2].text: Nothing in Metallia is expected to move. Yet beneath the oldest forges, master smiths find metals never recorded, and some swear the mountains themselves are rising.

realms.REALMS[1].cast[0].line.text: says the mountains are growing - no one else can see them move.

realms.REALMS[1].cast[1].line.text: cannot resist experimenting with the impossible new alloys, convinced every strange metal is an invention waiting to happen.

realms.REALMS[1].cast[2].line.text: studies the emerging ores, recognising crystalline patterns that should have vanished long ago.

realms.REALMS[2].lines[0].text: Floating islands drift in silence beneath endless skies. Crystal observatories, tranquil gardens and sky-bridges link the scattered realms of the Luminaries, who study stars and compose music - content in solitude, though some quietly wonder what it might mean to belong.

realms.REALMS[2].lines[1].text: They honour Akasa, Keeper of the Endless Sky, and Jyoti, Guardian of Quiet Light. Their oldest songs also remember the Ancients - the Dreamer of perfect symmetries broken, the River carrying every light forward, the Gatherer who calls the stars into their patterns - though few remember the notes.

realms.REALMS[2].lines[2].text: Lately, stars linger where they should have drifted on. Familiar constellations appear where none should exist. Melodies echo across empty skies long after the musicians fall silent.

realms.REALMS[2].cast[0].line.text: hears music on winds that should not exist.

realms.REALMS[2].cast[1].line.text: fills the twilight with colours, convinced every strange light is trying to tell a story.

realms.REALMS[2].cast[2].line.text: compares the night sky with maps so old that no one remembers who first drew them.

realms.REALMS[3].lines[0].text: Radiant crystal mountains glow with prism towers and pathways of living light. The Orders of Lantharnia wield hidden light, magnetism and memory, preserving knowledge older than history.

realms.REALMS[3].lines[1].text: They honour Smriti, Keeper of Memory, and Prakasha, Bearer of Hidden Light, believing nothing is truly lost, only waiting to be revealed. Older names lie deeper still - the Archivist who keeps what cannot be lost, the Weaver of every unseen bond, the Gambler who never chooses - etched into crystal so old that no one remembers who carved them or why.

realms.REALMS[3].lines[2].text: Lately, new constellations appear where the sky should be empty. Ancient crystals glow with colours never recorded. Forgotten observatories wake after millennia of silence.

realms.REALMS[3].cast[0].line.text: watches the stars from the highest prism tower - now something in the sky watches them back.

realms.REALMS[3].cast[1].line.text: notices colours in the crystals that no one can name.

realms.REALMS[3].cast[2].line.text: tends the oldest archives, puzzled that they no longer agree with the sky they were made to record.

realms.REALMS[4].lines[0].text: Deep beneath the mountains lies an underworld where the stone hums with ancient fire. The Memory Circle of Actinoria carry flames that could light stars or shatter realms. They are guardians of transformation, believing every ending gives rise to a new beginning.

realms.REALMS[4].lines[1].text: They honour Tejasvi, Keeper of the Inner Flame, and Parinama, Guardian of Transformation. Their oldest chants also remember the Ancients - the Transformer, whose touch lets matter itself change; Entropy, the slow undoing of all things; the Keeper, who binds what refuses to break - carved into caverns where no flame has ever reached, in a script no one reads.

realms.REALMS[4].lines[2].text: Lately, the mountains' rhythms no longer echo as they once did. New chambers appear where only solid rock should exist. The heartbeat of the world has begun to change.

realms.REALMS[4].cast[0].line.text: feels it - the slow, vast heartbeat of the rock, its rhythm changing for a while now, and has told no one.

realms.REALMS[4].cast[1].line.text: studies the oldest rocks, troubled they no longer seem as ancient as they should.

realms.REALMS[4].cast[2].line.text: finds hidden pathways where no tunnels should exist, though no map agrees they were ever there.

realms.REALMS[5].lines[0].text: At the heart of Elementoro lies Bond Basin, where the paths of all 118 cross, friendships are forged, rivalries ignite and destinies collide. Hy calls Nonaterra home, yet she always finds her way back here.

realms.REALMS[5].lines[1].text: Legend tells of the Ignis Core, buried at the realm's heart. It listens. Every bond, every friendship, every connection is recorded. Nothing is ever forgotten.

realms.REALMS[5].lines[2].text: The legend carries a warning. Every journey has a cost. Part of you is always left behind. And sometimes, something ancient follows you home.

realms.REALMS[5].lines[3].text: Now, strange events across the realms are breathing new life into stories long dismissed as myth.

realms.REALMS[5].cast[0].line.text: is drawn to currents of energy only he can sense.

realms.REALMS[5].cast[1].line.text: keeps noticing unexpected connections between events that should have nothing to do with one another.

realms.REALMS[5].cast[2].line.text: is convinced the shifting Basin follows a hidden logic that everyone else has overlooked.

realms.REALMS[5].note.text: None of them realise that beneath the Ignis Core, something has begun to wake...

universe.SCHOOL.quote.text: "We're incredibly excited to be the first school to showcase a model of the Quantum Tower in situ. This fantastic addition to our outdoor space will inspire and motivate our pupils on their journey of STEM learning. By enhancing our curriculum with the Elementoro cards and Elementoro book, we're bringing the periodic table to life across our lessons - sparking curiosity, creativity, and a lifelong passion for science."

deck[3].story.text: Be sees the fractures in everything - and knows exactly where they will break.

deck[3].horror.text: My wings are beautiful and lethal. Those who admire them longest are most at risk.

deck[4].story.text: B builds where others break and bend.

deck[4].horror.text: I hold everything together, yet nothing holds me.

deck[5].story.text: Carr shifts through endless forms, never fully certain which one is truly hers.

deck[5].horror.text: I can become anything - which means I have never been certain of what I truly am.

deck[6].story.text: Nit holds the world together in stillness.

deck[6].horror.text: From the quietest cycle a universe begins - and ends.

deck[7].story.text: Oxy burns fierce but fears the fire inside her own heart.
